reviewScope: Official Nepal EPS website notice pages/titles checked through 2026-10-13, cohort and sector isolation; no title-only rule promotion
reviewLimitations: The 2026-07-26 urgent applicant PDF is approximately 24.46 MB and its complete contents could not be obtained for text review; no exact rules were promoted.
The 2026-07-30 online-submission/passport notice is visible by official page title but the substantive scan/image content has not been reviewed.
Root Industry 2026 selection notices are a separate program; same-year notices must not be merged into first-phase general Manufacturing.
2026 regular/committed-worker departure announcements do not establish that 2026 first-phase EPS-TOPIK applicants have completed recruitment.
Nepal official notice index and search caches can lag; this is a dated review, not live regulatory monitoring.
